text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "In Switzerland more than 40% of energy consumption and about a third of climate-damaging CO2 emissions are attributable to the building industry.", "gist": "Swiss building industry accounts for over 40% of energy use and ~33% of CO2 emissions."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "subsidise the cost of the energy-saving renovation of buildings", "gist": "Subsidize energy-saving building renovations"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Building Programme", "gist": "A government initiative to improve energy efficiency in buildings"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "CO2 levy on fuels", "gist": "A tax on fuels used to fund the programme"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Through the Building Programme the Federal Government and the cantons hope to reduce energy consumption considerably in the Swiss building industry and also lower CO2 emissions.", "gist": "The programme aims to significantly cut energy use and CO2 emissions in Swiss buildings"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "partially financed by revenues from the CO2 levy on fuels", "gist": "Funding depends partly on CO2 fuel levy revenues"}]}
